same_run_concurrency_analysis.native_random_identity: two calls create different run IDs and therefore different aggregate streams
same_run_concurrency_analysis.deterministic_same_parent_identity: the qms.agent_run primary-key uniqueness check waits on an uncommitted competing insertion; after winner commit the loser fails before event allocation, and after winner rollback the waiter may proceed
same_run_concurrency_analysis.later_writer_overlap: a later writer cannot observe an uncommitted new AgentRun under the configured/default READ COMMITTED operation; after visibility it must lock the parent row before allocation
same_run_concurrency_analysis.reason: V2.2 does not bind the blocking event to the AgentRun parent identity or native aggregate type

replay_analysis.ambiguous_commit_rule: read-only retrieval or reconciliation is required; a duplicate deterministic create is rejected

failure_window_analysis.before_parent_insert: transaction has no persistent effect; retry may attempt the full operation
failure_window_analysis.parent_inserted_before_event: transaction rollback removes parent and inputs; retry may attempt the full operation
failure_window_analysis.event_inserted_before_outbox_or_audit: transaction rollback removes parent, inputs, event, outbox if present, and audit if present; retry may attempt the full operation
failure_window_analysis.ambiguous_after_commit: committed graph remains; deterministic duplicate parent creation is rejected before event allocation

serialization_conclusion.exact_blocker: V2.2 AgentRun.id and the DomainEvent event_id, aggregate_type, aggregate_id, event_type, and source bindings contradict the selected native producer's identity allocation and hardcoded values

continuation_scope: append-only V2.2 successor gate must bind the start and completion DomainEvent stream keys and native event types to the exact AgentRun identity before serialization can be promoted
